partnershipPlan: Two sepsis survivors or family members from the network's patient panel review the interview guide and the plain-language summary; the five sepsis leads meet monthly as an advisory group.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I can see she is septic at triage, but I cannot give anything until a doctor signs, and at night there is one doctor for the whole department.
items.implication: Explore who may start antibiotics at each site and at night.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The antibiotics are in the pharmacy room down the corridor; by the time I have found the key and the right one, the hour has gone.
items.implication: Observe where antibiotics are stored relative to triage.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: We came in at two in the morning and it felt as if everyone was waiting for someone else to decide.
Composite paraphrase: On the good days somebody is the sepsis person and chases everything; on the bad days nobody is.

summary: Four composite voices on ordering, drug access, night arrival and ownership.
